scope: Proposition 2.2 (Original joint-test domain) of the manuscript “Scale and conformal symmetry in four-dimensional operational quantum field theory” (preprints/Scale-and-conformal-symmetry-in-four-dimensional-operational-quantum-field-theory-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 282 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 485a44682f95ef0d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed finite ordered list of original fields and adjoints, the vacuum distribution has a unique tempered extension and its vacuum map has a continuous Hilbert-valued extension to all joint Schwartz kernels. The space Dold is Hilbert-dense and invariant under old field insertions and continuous joint polynomial insertions, with their prescribed adjoints. Finite field-label identities, covariance, locality, and the compact-slab Ward identities pass to this domain with their stated support conditions. For a compactly smeared original field B(f), each retained closed affiliated realization and its Hilbert adjoint agree on Dold with these insertion actions. This assertion also holds for an originally supplied Schwartz realization. It does not require Dold to be a graph core for that realization.
